desc: vaddrToFileOffset: Map virtual address to file offset using SegmentMap list. Used by PT_DYNAMIC/DT_STRTAB mapping.
safeSlice: Centralized, overflow-safe slice helper for file_buf; returns null on OOB.
Program header loop now calls appendSegmentAndMap to populate segments_list and segmaps for vaddr->file offset mapping.
PT_DYNAMIC parsing entry: find PT_DYNAMIC program header and collect DT_* entries (DT_NEEDED, DT_STRTAB, DT_STRSZ, DT_BIND_NOW).
Fallback search for .dynstr section when DT_STRTAB vaddr mapping fails.
appendSegmentAndMap: helper that appends a segment Section and a SegmentMap mapping (fileoff, filesize, vmaddr).
Symbol table parsing: iterate SHT_SYMTAB/SHT_DYNSYM, find linked strtab (sh_link), parse Elf*_Sym entries and populate imports/exports.
